title: ONNX 1.19 tests fails on osx-arm64 platfrom (eg ShapeInferenceError, TypeInferenceError)
body:
# Bug Report

### Describe the bug
Tests failed for the osx-arm64 platform for Python from 3.9 to 3.13.

### System information
OS Platform and Distribution: osx-arm64
ONNX version: 1.19.0, 1.19.1rc1
Python version: 3.9-3.13
GCC/Compiler version (if compiling from source): clang 17.0.6
CMake version: 3.31.2
Protobuf version: 5.29.3

### Reproduction instructions
pytest --pyargs onnx

### Expected behavior
Tests passed

```
IN ATTACHMENT
```
PR: https://github.com/AnacondaRecipes/onnx-feedstock/pull/16

The ONNX package was built successfully, but the test phase failed. The core issue is that many tests use assertRaises to verify that specific ONNX exceptions are thrown, but the actual exceptions being raised are different (mostly RuntimeError instead of checker.ValidationError or shape_inference.InferenceError). Additionally, there are issues with custom schema registration/deregistration persistence between tests.

Could the problem be due to using a protobuf version <6?
Thanks in advance.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: My conclusion is that throwing exceptions across shared libaries (from onnx.so to onnx_cpp2py_export.pyd ) could lead to translation errors on libc++. This may have been fixed on the main branch because onnx_cpp2py_export.pyd links with `onnx_objects`. For the upcoming onnx 1.19, a temporary solution is to ignore the test failures on MacOS? or should we back-port  #7087 to 1.19.1?
